topic: In the anime, Smoker sends Luffy toward Gold Roger's scaffold without knowing who he is
title: Smoker Pointed Luffy At Gold Roger's Scaffold
description: In the anime, Smoker's first encounter with Luffy starts as a wrong turn. He sends a wanted rookie toward Gold Roger's scaffold without knowing who he is. Was that bad luck or a plan?
comment: Was Smoker's first mistake bad luck, or did he know exactly who Luffy was?

lines.text: Smoker pointed the most wanted rookie in East Blue straight at Gold Roger's scaffold.

shot.fallback: marine captain pointing down a stone street toward an old wooden platform, anime style

lines.text: He didn't know who Luffy was. He thought he was just a tourist.

shot.fallback: young straw hat pirate smiling in a busy town street, anime style

lines.text: In the anime, their first meeting really starts with that wrong turn.

shot.search: Smoker Luffy first meeting Loguetown anime
shot.fallback: marine captain looking at a young pirate with a suspicious squint, anime style

lines.text: Episode 48 has Luffy standing right where Roger once stood.

shot.fallback: young pirate standing on an old wooden platform in a town square, anime style

lines.text: Then Buggy grabs him, and Smoker watches the whole thing unfold.

shot.fallback: clown pirate with a grin holding a young pirate over a platform, anime style

lines.text: Smoker remembers Roger's final day, twenty-two years earlier.

shot.fallback: young marine watching a crowd gather around a scaffold, sepia tone, anime style

lines.text: Then Luffy's grin hits him. It's the same smile Roger once wore.

shot.fallback: two smiling pirates side by side, one older, one young, anime style

lines.text: Here's my read: the anime makes that first encounter pure bad luck.

shot.fallback: marine captain looking at a map with a confused expression, anime style

lines.text: In the manga, he doesn't know the Straw Hats exist until the scaffold moment.

shot.fallback: marine officer reading a wanted poster in a dim office, anime style

lines.text: Some fans say the anime flashback proves Smoker watched Roger in person.

shot.fallback: young marine as a child in a crowd, anime style

lines.text: The wiki says it isn't canon, so the flashback stays a fan debate.

shot.fallback: open book with a question mark over a town square, anime style

lines.text: So the first meeting was luck, not a plan.

shot.fallback: marine captain shrugging beside a young pirate, anime style

lines.text: And that's only the first thing Smoker got wrong about Luffy.

shot.fallback: marine captain staring at a pirate across a street, anime style

lines.text: So the rookie got pointed at the scaffold, and nobody meant it.

shot.fallback: young pirate in a straw hat on an old platform at dusk, anime style
